metadata.title: Chip stocks fall amid bond selloff and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
3 hours ago
Chip stocks fall amid bond selloff and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Tuesday's premarket action:
Shares of Micron Technology, Marvell Technology and Intel tumbled 5% as investment sentiment toward U.S. chip stocks soured after global bond yields reached multiyear highs. Nvidia was down over 2%.
Oracle's stock declined about 3.5% as software stocks also suffered from a broad sell-off in the technology sector. Palantir edged 0.5% lower.
Coherent shed nearly 7% as traders sought to take profit following the optical technology provider's recent rally.
Home Depot is up 1% ahead of the retailer reporting its second-quarter earnings before the opening bell — which are likely to reveal more information about consumer health in the U.S. Analysts expect revenue to rise just 1% to $47.2 billion.
